assessments.reasoning: The emitter maps Mts/Mjs to Mjs and Cts/Cjs to Cjs and applies the extension to the output path. The claim is narrower than the source function and concerns emitted .mts and .cts inputs under NodeNext only.

One compiler run under the frozen NodeNext configuration emitted both out/entry.mjs and out/entry.cjs. The files also contained the expected distinct ESM and CommonJS export shapes. No emitted module was executed.

challenge.method: Checked the emitter's endpoint mapping and compiled both explicitly exported inputs in one isolated NodeNext case, comparing suffixes and inspecting output text.
challenge.results: The verified compiler emitted entry.mjs and entry.cjs with different module forms. Mode or runtime behavior outside the frozen profile was not tested.

limitations: This covers output file extensions in the named compiler profile. Packager behavior, Node loading, run-time interoperability and media formats have separate scopes.
